name: WHDLoad
notes: The standard 18.9 build 6601 and its DIC 1.3, RawDIC 6.1 and Patcher 1.06 helpers each have byte-identical copies in C: and the Expansion drawer.
The pinned user archive supplies matching binaries, documentation and Expansion/WHDLoad/S templates. BCWB supplies the altered S: files, four drawer icons and the Devs/Kickstarts.info placeholder.
BCWB copies the payload directly. The upstream installer, additional language drawers, Kickstart images and game slaves are outside the stock payload.
This manifest owns the full Expansion drawer, including its reference copy of WHDLoadCD32. The companion whdloadcd32 manifest owns the command in C:.
